topic_title: Reducing Risk — Accepting or Yielding Right-of-Way
prompt: What defensive driving strategy should be applied when approaching a 'stale green' traffic light?

options.text: Hover your foot over the brake (cover brake) and anticipate a yellow signal
Floor the accelerator to pass the crosswalk before the signal changes
Shift the transmission into neutral and engage the emergency parking brake
Flash your headlights twice to signal crossing traffic to remain stopped
